items.title: Viewer panes join hero mode
items.text: Zoom/hero focus now works with viewer panes too, so a rendered doc, code file, or website can take the spotlight just like a terminal pane.

items.title: Pane banners survive restarts
items.text: Banners you set now persist across app relaunch and session re-attach, so your status/context sticks around instead of vanishing on quit.

items.title: Cleaner, steadier banner look
items.text: The banner card is now composited off a single pane-colored element with a stable pane-matched hue, dropping the focus-reactive glass effect so it no longer shifts color when you switch windows.

items.title: Banners never block resizing
items.text: Long banners reflow to the pane width instead of pinning a minimum size, so a banner can't stop you from shrinking a pane.

items.title: Smoother runtime color changes
items.text: Background color updates now apply in a single, accessibility-aware pass for cleaner transitions.
